question: Where was the headquarters of International Financial Services Centres Authority (IFSCA) set up in India in April 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gandhinagar**__.**__​__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The International Financial Services Centres Authority (IFSCA) was established in** April 2020**.
 
• International Financial Services Centre Authority is a statutory body that was established through IFSCA Act 2019.
 
• It was established on** April 27, 2020, **and is headquartered in** Gandhinagar Gujarat.**
 
• It consists of a total of 9 members appointed for a term of three years.
 
• There will be one member nominated by **RBI, IRDA, SEBI, and PFRDA each.**
 
• It also consists of two members from the central government and the other two members are nominated by a selection committee.
